en.core-focus: Unity Programming · Live Service Games · UI/UX Systems · Tools · Performance
en.statement-line1: Senior Unity Programmer with 7 years of experience shipping and supporting mobile live-service games. Focused on UI, gameplay systems, performance optimization, and custom tools that speed up iteration for designers and artists.
en.tech-stack-nexon: - Unity (Anime Style, Gacha, Squad Based RPG Game - Android / iOS / Steam)
en.ba-1: Cut stage-loading overhead by converting JSON data to MemoryPack binary format, reducing parsing memory usage by over 80% and parse time by 70%
en.ba-2: Implemented seasonal content, including a railroad placement mini-game
en.ba-4: Built custom tools for scenario writers and content teams, including a GUI settings editor for JSON-based settings and Roslyn-based DAO validation checks
en.ba-3: Mentored junior programmers, conducted code reviews, delegated tasks, and led regular check-ins
en.openworld-gas: Implemented core combat abilities with Unreal Gameplay Ability System (GAS)
en.openworld-blueprint: Enabled designers to create buffs in Blueprint without programmer support
en.action-rpg-prototype: Led rapid prototyping as the sole programmer
en.action-rpg-conversion: Converted a top-down action game to full 3D and implemented core systems, including combat mechanics and UI components such as inventory
en.dingcom-art-support: Provided technical support for the art team on character customization and animation workflows
en.dingcom-combat: Designed and implemented the combat system
en.dingcom-multiplayer: Used Mirror library for multiplayer functionality
en.tech-stack-smash: - Unity (PVP Battle Action Game - Steam / Android / iOS)
en.smash-legacy-code: Refactored legacy code and reduced technical debt to facilitate easier feature additions
en.smash-tool-dev: Created, improved, and maintained tools to enhance content development productivity (maps, game modes, characters, VFX)
en.hero60-dev-cycle: Worked on project from prototype to release, and major live-service updates for guild systems and raids
en.hero60-unity-tools: Created Unity editor tools to streamline testing and development workflows
en.hero60-excel-vba: Developed an integrated Excel+VBA solution that enabled efficient balancing by allowing team members to set up party combinations and calculate DPS based on character, equipment, skill, and set buff data tables without connecting to the game
en.billiards-dev-cycle: Worked on project from prototype to release, and major live-service updates for character systems and guilds
en.portfolio-description-hexgem: Classic match-3 portfolio project focused on simple brush-style interaction and readable gameplay feedback
en.workflow-communication: Communicate with various cooperating/involved co-workers (Designer, Manager, Artist, QA etc.)
